title: Wartime intelligence agencies run by financiers

tellings.quote: People don't know, there was also another American intelligence agency dedicated to South America, which is the Office for the Coordination of Inter-American Affairs.

plain: A researcher who goes by the name JASON, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that during World War II the United States had another, little-known spy agency aimed at South America, called the Office for the Coordination of Inter-American Affairs. He names William Donovan, Allen Dulles, Nelson Rockefeller, William Stephenson and Charles Hambro, and describes the wartime spy agencies of America and Britain as run by men from the world of money. If he is right, the same circle of finance and secrecy shaped the agencies that later kept UFO secrets.
